issue.description:
ADR-005 notes its new doctor check reads assignment state directly, making its notion of 'excluded from the ready frontier' a second implementation of a rule the claim eligibility query (R001) already owns; the two can silently diverge and report different frontiers. Extract the exclusion conditions (base_status, assignment, manual block, unfinished blockers) into one shared definition used by both claim selection and the doctor check, and add a test asserting both surfaces report identical exclusions on a fixture that exercises each exclusion reason.

---
Priority: P3
Created by: weave strand
issue.title: Share one readiness-exclusion predicate between claim eligibility and doctor's ready_frontier check

issue.description:
Parent: beadrs-5a0dc962. The current docs teach the exact pattern that produced 17 stashes and erased another worker's uncommitted hour (beadrs-e167fde8):
- BUILD_PROCEDURE.md "Step 1/2" runs cargo build inside /home/coding/bead-rs and "Commit Pinning" reproduces via `git clone ... && git checkout 6561869...`.
- pinned-binaries/COMMITS.md "Usage in Build Steps" instructs `git checkout $PRE_ATTEMPT_COMMIT` / `git checkout $FEATURE_COMMIT` in whatever tree you are in.

Rewrite:
- Put the rule in one sentence near the top of BUILD_PROCEDURE.md: pinned binaries are built from a git-archive extraction in ~/scratch via scripts/build-from-archive.sh; never stash, reset, or checkout inside the shared /home/coding/bead-rs checkout.
- Replace every clone/checkout/cargo-build-in-place instruction with the script invocation, including the --features attempt-resolution variant.
- AGENTS.md "Engineering": add the same one-sentence rule next to "Preserve unrelated and untracked work."
- Document the reproducibility boundary: legacy pinned binaries (bead-pre-feature, bead-pre-attempt-resolution, bead-attempt-resolution-*) were built before deterministic builds and are verify-by-hash-only against their .metadata.json — never by rebuilding; only script-built pins are reproducible.

Acceptance:
- grep -rin 'git checkout\|git stash\|git reset' BUILD_PROCEDURE.md pinned-binaries/COMMITS.md AGENTS.md yields no step instructing a builder to mutate a shared checkout (historical incident prose may mention the words; instructions may not).
- Every documented build path routes through scripts/build-from-archive.sh.
- The 17 pre-existing stashes are left untouched; this child's closing note lists the full `git stash list` output for the operator.
issue.title: Rewrite build docs so the archive script is the only sanctioned build path
